note: Representation-only profile for the supplied German Bohnanza Base Game Version 5.4 (2023). Rules come only from assigned sources. A supplied seed reproducibly chooses the start player and all shuffle behavior.

players.coins: nonnegative int counting flipped bean cards; each coin is one physical card whose bean identity is no longer represented

deck: bean_id (bottom to top; final item is next draw)
pending_received: bean_id (owner-chosen planting order, one list per player)

representation_choices.inventory_invariant: The total physical inventory is 104: every named bean card in hands, fields, deck, discard, revealed, pending_received and reserve, plus every player coin (a flipped bean card).
representation_choices.trade_refs: A proposal stores immutable snapshot references. Source zones do not change on proposal and exact referenced cards transfer atomically only on acceptance.
representation_choices.pending_limit: At most one proposal is pending. This serializes physical negotiation without adding a trade-legality rule.
representation_choices.phase3_order: Any player with pending_received cards, plus the active player while revealed cards remain, may supply the next plant action. Draw remains unavailable until all such cards are planted.
representation_choices.harvest_boundary: Any player may harvest their own legal field at every stable decision state. No interrupt is inserted inside one apply_action transition.
representation_choices.terminal: Terminal states use phase terminal, terminal true, winner equal to the unique tiebreak winner, pending null, and no legal actions.
